message: —The day has finally arrived.

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ooh, my heart's pounding！ I love this kind of atmosphere, but it really does make me nervous.」

name: Ririmu
message: 「People make it sound so easy, going 'just relax!' Ahaha, yeah, no way that's happening~」

name: Asahi
message: 「Even so, you all look like you're in good spirits.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Hmm, so the preliminaries are being held here.」
The Martial Festival preliminaries are held across every facility on campus. Though for the indoor training ground group, it might not feel particularly new since they always use it for practice.

name: Ririmu
message: 「Sensei, aren't they using the arena for the preliminaries？」

name: Iori
message: 「If you're lucky, you might get assigned to the arena. We set up and inspected all the equipment for the preliminaries, so it's going to be pretty flashy！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Whoo-hoo, now I'm getting hyped！」

name: Asahi
message: 「...And next week is already the main tournament.」
At the edge of the training ground, plenty of competitors have already started warming up. Everyone here is a top performer from their respective class.
From here on out, neither grade nor class matters—it's a pure contest of skill. Everyone will be competing on the exact same stage.

name: Iori
message: 「Don't let the atmosphere swallow you up, everyone. Just do what you always do and you'll be fine.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Well, I'm sure the students in our class will be fine.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Alright, I'm gonna go out there and crush it！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Heck yeah, I'm breezing through the preliminaries in first place！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Everyone's certainly full of energy.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, looks like I don't have anything to worry about.」

name: Iori
message: 「Alright then, it's about time for everyone to head out. Don't mix up the time or location~」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「W-Wait, Sensei, aren't you forgetting something？！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Yeah! Since we're here and all, send us off with something way cooler than that!」

name: Asahi
message: 「Please, Iori-sensei.」
I'd held back, thinking it might sound forced if I made some grand speech here, but it seems they actually wanted one.

name: Iori
message: 「...Let's see. There's no point lecturing you about technique or mindset at this late hour.」

name: Iori
message: 「Because you all already know everything you need to. That's just how much I trust you.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everything I could do, everything I could teach you—I believe I've already passed it all on leading up to these preliminaries.」

name: Iori
message: 「In that sense, you could say the work I needed to do with Takamura Class is already finished.」

name: Iori
message: 「Everyone, thank you so much. You’ve really followed me well. I thank you from the bottom of my heart.」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Teacher...」
Setsugekka wears a somewhat complicated expression.

name: Iori
message: 「It’s okay, you all are already strong enough！ Every one of you absolutely has the ability to pass the preliminaries！」

name: Iori
message: 「However, there are no certainties in a match. The other competitors have also overcome grueling training to be here today.」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m sure it won’t be an easy fight.」

name: Iori
message: 「The preliminaries are a randomized, irregular round-robin. The eight competitors with the best records will advance to the main tournament.」

name: Iori
message: 「Year level doesn’t matter in the preliminary leagues. That includes talented third-year competitors like Victoria and Shizuku.」

name: Iori
message: 「And... as you know, there will also be matches between members of Takamura Class.」
Tension runs across everyone’s faces.

name: Iori
message: 「But this is the preliminaries. Even if you lose, it’s not the end. Whether you make it to the main tournament is determined by your overall match record.」
The advantage of this irregular league system is that even if you lose, a chance to advance to the main tournament remains.
By reducing the probability of being weeded out due to bad matchups or simple bad luck, it ensures that true ability is tested.

name: Iori
message: 「I believe that we can all make it to the main tournament！」

name: Iori
message: 「It’s a cliché way to end this, but... everyone, do your best. I’ll always be by your side, cheering you on.」

name: Iori
message: 「Now, go get ’em！！！」

name: Asahi
message: 「Iori-sensei, I’m heading out. I promise to win and return victorious.」

name: Iori
message: 「Ah, Asahi’s hard work is second to none. Just fight as you always do, and all that’s left is to win！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Watch me, Teach! I’m gonna show everyone in the venue exactly what my world is all about!」

name: Iori
message: 「I’m looking forward to it. Everyone will be watching as Ririmu shines up on that stage！」

name: Ririmu
message: 「Woo-hoo, I’m getting so hyped up~♪」

name: Setsugekka
message: 「Ariiight！ I can’t lose either, I’m gonna... throw everything I learned from you at them！」

name: Iori
message: 「No need to hold back, go out there and give it your all！」

name: Momiji
message: 「In that case, I’ll go get it over with real quick.」

name: Iori
message: 「Hahaha, same old Momiji, huh. That's the spirit. Go show them the full power of the current Suzakuin generation.」

name: Momiji
message: 「Okaaay~」
Their smiles brimming with eagerness, everyone dashes off. All right, the preliminary match is finally about to begin.
